summary_zh:
這裡有不同的入口，前往不同的地點，其中一個入口需要停車費，但廁所也在這裡，付了停車費，裡面的廁所就不用付錢，但如果去燈塔那頭就不用付費，但也沒廁所。 (2026.05)

這個半島，我覺得早上、傍晚都蠻值得來的，我個人都有來過，到了停車場，往旁邊走會有步道，可以遠看到黑沙灘。

值得花 60 - 90 分鐘來這裡欣賞南部海景。
summary_en: There are several entrances leading to different spots. One entrance requires a parking fee and provides a restroom; the fee also covers restroom use. The path to the lighthouse is free of charge but has no restroom. I recommend visiting the peninsula in the morning or evening. After parking, walk along the side trail to reach a viewpoint with views of the black sand beach. Allocate 60–90 minutes to enjoy the southern seascape.
